comments.text:
Each public function takes (node, lens) and returns ONE visual value per CONTRACTS.md.
No DOM, no three.js, no side effects on import. Data in, value out.

CONTRACT 1 (NODE): nodes carry raw attrs (status/type/energy/… possibly null) plus a
  normalized block `node.n` where every quantitative field is 0..1 (or null if the raw
  value was absent). We read `node.n.<field>` for sizing/y, raw attrs for hue/shape/highlight.
CONTRACT 2 (LENS): lens.hueBy / shapeBy / sizeBy / yMode / highlight / score select the mapping.

EXTENSION POINTS are marked `// EXTEND:` — add a case to the relevant switch to grow a lever.

───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PALETTE — exported so panel/legend can reuse the exact same colors.
  status: the FROZEN status hex map (do not change these values).
  domain/type: two DISTINCT 6-hex categorical scales.
  NULL: the fallback for any absent categorical value.
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROZEN — must match the contract exactly.

comments.text:
scoreFor(node, lens) → number in 0..1

Weighted average of the lens score terms over the node's NORMALIZED metrics
(node.n, each already 0..1 or null — produced by data.js per CONTRACT 1).

Per CONTRACT 2, lens.score = { wAge, wRecency, wChurn, wEnergy, wUrgent, wImportant },
each weight 0..1. The term→metric mapping is FROZEN by the spec:

    wAge       → n.age
    wRecency   → n.recency
    wChurn     → n.churn
    wEnergy    → n.energy
    wUrgent    → n.urgent
    wImportant → n.important

Rule: sum (weight * value) over terms where weight > 0 AND value is non-null,
divide by the sum of those qualifying weights. If nothing qualifies, return 0.
EXTENSION POINT: to add a new score lever, add a { w, v } pair here and a matching
